input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume cap on us. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "non-cancellable" and "volume" return nothing relevant (the only "commitment" hit, p0143, is the no-agency clause). Fees are payable only as set out in the Fee Schedule (§11/p0084), with additional fees arising only if we choose to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations (§2/p0028). Maintenance runs in a renewable one-year term rather than a fixed multi-year obligation (§10/p0065), and we may terminate the whole Agreement for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice (§17(b)/p0118), so there is no locked-in spend without an exit. This meets the preferred position (fees for usage or ordered services only). Note: the commercial exposure sits in Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule), which is not reproduced in this text — worth confirming the schedule itself carries no committed user/location counts or minimum annual maintenance spend.
